lines.text: Baasha struck down Nadab at Gibbethon, reigned in his place, and killed the entire household of Jeroboam.
Baasha reigned in Tirzah twenty-four years, and the LORD's word through Nathan son of Hanani announced judgment on his house.
Zimri, commander of half his chariots, conspired against Elah, killed him, reigned, and destroyed Baasha's entire household.
Zimri reigned in Tirzah for forty days, then burned the palace citadel upon himself when Omri besieged the city.
Ahab son of Omri reigned in Samaria twenty-two years, married Jezebel, served Baal, and set up an Asherah pole.
